claim_boundary: CAD/depth geometry and expected information only; no IK, collision, planning, trajectory, gripper, or grasp claim.

information_model.definition: CAD surface area times texture-gradient weight times independent residual density; propagated by the pinhole yaw Jacobian.

stop_criterion.criterion: measured P7.2 yaw standard deviation <= configured threshold; prospective Fisher projections rank candidates only and cannot terminate the gate
